body.message:
Two access cards were given to me by your staff at check-in. I even sent a video, and you said it’s not our card, which clearly shows there was a mistake in handover. Otherwise, I wouldn’t have this card.

One of the cards didn’t work from day one. I was busy with moving, but I informed reception early on and they told me to contact you. Please check this properly and fix the issue instead of denying it.
